limitations: SMALL front is exhaustive only for the existing bounded synthetic benchmark axis.
CONTROLLED fronts are non-dominated only within the fixed observed candidate union, not over all legal paths.
The controlled candidate union comes from fully completed standard 8→16 Beam runs plus complete terminal-audit neighbourhoods under the unchanged baseline-v0 and V1A scorers.
Terminal observation is materialized only after search/audit decisions finish, so Pareto instrumentation does not consume their wall-clock budget.
Frozen references are attainable sampled envelopes, not admissible bounds or global optima.
